Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You provide software and application expertise and analysis to support implementation of the strategy and the solution.

How you will contribute

You will provide expert consultation for a specific software or application, leading on issues and resolutions, optimizing service delivery to meet business demands and the service operations strategy. To excel in this role, you will recommend steps to optimize investments and benefits and to mitigate risks for a specific application. In addition, you will identify suppliers, evaluate them, on-board new vendors, and oversee them, work with project resources to provide design collateral and to configure software components that are aligned with security policy and governance, ensure adherence configuration standards and processes, and share your knowledge of the technology with relevant stakeholders.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • Working with multiple vendors and encouraging collaboration for a specific software or application
  • Working on complex projects
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Service delivery, support and excellence
  • Project management
  • Working in a global IT function with regional or global responsibilities in an environment similar to Mondelēz International
  • Working with IT outsourcing providers using frameworks such as the IT International Library
  • Working with internal and external teams and leading when necessary

Job Profile Summary

 

You will be part of the MDS Order Fulfillment Product team, which is responsible for Order Fulfillment and Delivery across SAP & non- SAP technologies.

 

You will develop a deep understanding of the opportunities, risks and issues facing the business function and will advise on possible solutions, translating business needs into detailed product requirements for complete resolution. You will support Product Manager in realizing the product strategy through incremental improvements to the product, designing business scenarios and use cases, through excellent partnering with business stakeholders.

 

Job Description

 

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

 

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.

 

Mondelez International is seeking a highly motivated, hands-on and accountable individual to join our team as team member in MDS Order Fulfillment Product team.

The role requires excellent collaboration, both functional and cross-functional, with global and regional business stakeholders to drive alignment and deep understanding of key system requirements and associated changes.  The role must influence and guide stakeholders, creating materials that support understanding and long-term sustainability.  The successful candidate must be able to listen and learn, resolve problems and conflict and relies on detailed process and systems understanding.

This pivotal role will be responsible for the successful design and delivery of the Order Fulfillment Products, ensuring alignment with organizational goals across SAP and other technologies in this area. You will act as a bridge between technology and business teams, ensuring system readiness and on-time execution across the full program scope. This position will be crucial in overseeing the projects throughout their duration, ensuring seamless coordination between global, regional and local teams.

We look for someone with:

·       Strong understanding of processes and related technology functionalities in Order Fulfillment and Delivery area and able to translate various business requirements into technology solutions

·       Strong business acumen, familiar with standards and controls

·       Abreast of latest technology trends and the opportunities/risks they present to the business

·       Experienced in analysing and breaking down problems and information using structured frameworks and methodologies

·       Is proactive, autonomous, and hungry to deliver

·       Is focused on problem solving, raises red flags, and asks for help early when needed.

·       Can meet the demands of a global project across multiple time-zones

·       Is committed to the successful completion of all deliverables he/she is accountable and/or responsible for, on time, in full.

·       Is a team player, operates and collaborates in close interaction with other team members (e.g. Business Leads, PMO etc.), other streams and functions (e.g. Order Capture, Customer Care, Logistic Operations, Sales, Master Data etc.), and external counterparts (e.g. Accenture BPO, Accenture Support, etc.), global, regional, BU and market OTC stakeholders

·       Drives outcomes and deliverables independently, with limited information and without waiting for others

How you will contribute

You will:

·       Report to the MDS OF Product Manager

·       Own the functional deployment of specific OF digital platforms (SAP and non-SAP) as well as related process redesign in line with business relevant strategic and operational objectives

·       Advise for the adoption of respective technical solutions across BUs, ensuring smooth operational integration

·       Support continuous improvement of the digital platform capabilities and efficiency ensuring operational excellence and help achieving SLA targets

·       Advise on process reengineering and continuous improvement opportunities to streamline and standardize global templates

·       Identify implementation opportunities of the digital platforms in line with agreed priorities and strategy

·       Alongside OF Product Manager, advice for the interdependencies and cross-functional alignment

·       Monitor process outcome KPIs, vital signs, and new technology adoption, including relevant controls as designed by relevant owners

·       Lead design workshops in OF area, supporting key decisions and technical solution proposals, in alignment with Business and Technology partner teams.

·       Prepare and present design artifacts to governance boards and stakeholders, with clear traceability and business relevance.

·       Prepare and deliver product user guides and training materials to end users and support leads

·       Lead the design or business scenarios, process flows and use cases to maximize adoption and value

·       Work in close collaboration with the key stakeholders: OF Business Leads, OTC Data Governance Leads, Technology partner Leads/SMEs, and MDS Leads/SMEs, Global OTC PMO, among others

·       Assists in removing functional barriers and silo mentality

 

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

A strong drive to own outcomes and make a difference, with the following qualifications and traits:

·       Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in Order Fulfillment, including system deployment across multiple countries, within a region or across regions.

·       Robust technical proficiency in SAP: able to navigate transactions (especially in order capture, fullfilment, and delivery creation), tables, and data structures independently.

·       Proven track record in driving project execution, not only participation — including testing, requirements and process documentation, and problem-solving.

·       Strong analytical mindset with capability to design/improve processes, think critically, and propose fit-for-purpose solutions.

·       Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work in complex matrix environments and across cultures.

·       A business and process mindset with a desire to understand and harmonize our system landscape through hands-on partnership with 3rd parties on development.

·       Able to influence and drive a strategic agenda cross-functionally and across organisations.

·       Articulation and clarity: ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and concisely. Maintain a "keep-it-simple" approach in all communications. Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

·       Pragmatism: approach problem-solving with a practical and results-oriented mindset. Approach issues with a proactive mindset, focusing on finding solutions.

·       Cross-cultural collaboration: exhibit cultural sensitivity and adapt communication styles as needed. Foster strong relationships with diverse teams across different countries.

·       Resilience: demonstrate resilience in the face of challenges, maintaining a positive and solution-oriented mindset during testing phases and technical setbacks.

·       Team spirit: foster a collaborative and positive team spirit, encouraging open communication and constructive problem-solving. Inspire and motivate the countries with enthusiasm and a can-do attitude, reinforcing a culture of collective success and shared responsibility.

·       Adaptability: embrace the dynamic nature of the project, adapting quickly to changes, and inspiring the team to approach setbacks with flexibility and creativity.

·       A doer — able to work autonomously, take ownership, and get things done with minimal supervision.

·       Comfortable with ambiguity and able to connect dots quickly, following instructions even if partial and turning them into actionable steps and deliverables.

·       Proactive communicator: reports issues/risks, requests help and doesn’t assume others will fill the gaps.

·       Strong accountability and pride in quality and timeliness of deliverables.

·       Able to think ahead, pre-empt roadblocks, and build contingency where needed.

·       Cultural sensitivity and experience working across different and multiple countries, BUs and ideally regions.

·       High energy, professional maturity, and strong ownership mentality.

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.

Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
